title: FLA import: bitmap library display names not decoded — CMediaBits Contents records are scanned for sounds only, every imported bitmap is renamed 'Bitmap N'
description: FIXED. Read-side CMediaBits display-name decoding. parseFla8Contents now builds a bitmaps Map<mediaNum,{name}> from CMediaBits catalog records (registerCMediaBitsObject mirrors registerCMediaSoundObject; inline body after the CMediaBits FFFF decl + backref-tag scan), added to Fla8ContentsInfo. buildFla8Document (flash8-import.ts) uses contents.bitmaps.get(mediaNum)?.name ?? 'Bitmap N' for createBitmap. Verify: full ordered build exit 0; @flash/core tests green except the 2 KNOWN pre-existing empty-bytematch WRITER failures (task 1423, confirmed identical on clean base). Tests: new bitmap-names.test.ts (a) round-trip 'Hero' survives saveRealFla->tryLoadRealFla, (b) evaporatingdrip.fla Media 4 imports as 'metal'; updated bitmap-debug.test.ts to expect Magnet's authored names (Tangerine Fusion/Sage Foam/Quantum Foam/Metallic Foam). Docs/21 sec 8.10 clarified. Read-side only; no writer/cfb-write touched.
